releaseNotes:
Official Release v1.3.103:
- SCALE INVENTORY INTEGRATION: Live RG14 USB Scale gram readings directly in Alcohol Control tab.
- BOTTLE TARE & CALIBRATION: One-touch 'Set Full (g)' and 'Set Empty (g)' instant weight capture.
- AUTO-CAPTURE STABILITY: Automatic weight recognition when bottle rests on scale.
- TOUCH ROLE BUTTONS: Replaced system select dropdowns with high-contrast touch pills for flawless kiosk touch editing.
- STAFF QUICK-SWITCH: Tap employee role badge to cycle access level seamlessly.
- BARTENDER BARCODE ACCESS: Verified manager card authentication for bartender access.
- 100% Quality Standard: Verified with 0 errors and 0 warnings.
